sources.title: Sakura Miko (1st costume)
sources.excerpt: It's a [[nontraditional miko]] costume consisting of a [[frilled kimono|frilled]] [[sleeveless kimono|sleeveless]], [[backless kimono|backless]]/[[sideless kimono|sideless]] [[kimono]] top with a conventional shirt collar and a red [[tassel]], [[white sleeves|white]] [[wide sleeves|wide]] [[detached sleeves]], a [[red skirt|red]] [[hakama short skirt]] with a [[hip vent]], a red [[thigh strap]] on one leg and a [[frilled thigh strap]] on the other [[uneven legwear|uneven]] [[tabi]] (a [[white socks|white]] [[single sock|sock]] and a [[white thighhighs|white]] [[lace-trimmed thighhighs|lace-trimmed]] [[single thighhigh|thighhigh]]) and [[geta]].
